pose-doc.png is the Pose Landmarker example image from Google developer documentation:
https://developers.google.com/static/mediapipe/images/solutions/examples/pose_detector.png

Source page: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker/web_js
The documentation identifies its content as CC BY 4.0 except where otherwise noted. Attribution: Google, MediaPipe Pose Landmarker documentation. This public, non-user test image is used only to verify the actual local detector; it is not live camera evidence or an original Glint image.

speech-jfk.wav is the whisper.cpp sample clip (JFK inaugural excerpt):
https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/master/samples/jfk.wav
U.S. presidential speech, public domain. Used only to verify the local neural VAD hears real speech; it is not user microphone content.
